name: Text
description:
Text in one of the type roles, with a colour role. It sets type, not layout: margins
belong to the container (Stack's gap).
signature: ({ as: Element, variant, tone, weight, numeric, mono, truncate, align, className, children, ...rest }: TextProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: align
props.description: Text alignment, in the reading direction.

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

props.name: numeric
props.description: Tabular, aligned figures for numbers that change or line up.

props.name: tone
props.description: The semantic tone. Use danger and warning for consequences and states.

props.name: truncate
props.description: Cut to one line with an ellipsis (`true`), or to a number of lines. Pair with a tooltip or the full text nearby.

props.name: weight
props.description: `medium` or `semibold` over the role's own weight.
